title: •Galen’s Fighter
caption: •_IG-2000_ (V)
heading: •Galen’s Fighter (V)
game_text: May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. If Black Leader piloting, adds one battle destiny. If it just took off, may use its hyperspeed and land. Immune to attrition < 7 if Galen on table, even while landed.
game_text_lines:
May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. If Black Leader
piloting, adds one battle destiny. If it just took
off, may use its hyperspeed and land. Immune to
attrition < 7 if Galen on table, even while landed.
base_lore: IG-88’s assault starfighter. Custom designed. Boasts a Kuat Galaxy-15 engine from a Nebulon-B frigate. Heavy ion cannon often used to disable starships before boarding.

notes: COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (756×1100) over IG-2000 on the printed blue Dark starship frame. ART WINDOW IS BLANK WHITE on this slip (the white also runs over the right margin where the copyright line sits) — contrary to the set note listing Galen's Fighter among the slips with their own art; the crop's centre is 100% pure white, so NO slip_art / rect; art from the printed IG-2000 scan as usual. Title bar: starship disc (as printed), '•Galen’s Fighter' (curly ’, upright — not italic), destiny 2 (printed 4). LORE BOX PRINTED EMPTY (solid black) → lore '' (printed lore in base_lore). Right of the lore box: the Dagobah expansion ring (Yoda-eye sphere), as printed; no Episode I. Banner STARFIGHTER: TRANSPORT (printed STARFIGHTER: TRILON AGGRESSOR); POWER 3 / MANEUVER 4 / HYPERSPEED 5 (printed 3/3/3); scomp ring at the top-left of the text box (as printed); deploy 3 / forfeit 6 (printed 4 / 3); game text 4 lines; icon column: Nav Computer (astromech dome on red) only — the printed card's second icon (Independent) is gone; then the diamond-17 set mark. Caption '•IG-2000 (V)' with IG-2000 italic. CHANGES vs printed IG-2000 (Dagobah): title, destiny 4→2, lore removed, banner model, maneuver 3→4, hyperspeed 3→5, deploy 4→3, forfeit 3→6, Independent icon dropped, game text replaced (printed: 'May add 1 pilot (must be a smuggler or bounty hunter) and 2 passengers. Maneuver +3 and immune to attrition < 3 if IG-88 piloting. Ion Cannon may deploy here.'). Slip text matches the stub. Base lore matches the 745 scan (apostrophe in IG-88’s taken as curly). Base scans: Dagobah-D-ig2000.gif (745) is the Glossary 2.0 errata face ('Ion Cannon may deploy aboard') — art only, same art as the archive face; Dagobah-D-ig2000-decipher-archive.gif (350, printed face) also downloaded. Modern: VB4-D-rogueshadow-pre.gif (Virtual Block 4 reissue renamed 'Rogue Shadow', same IG-2000 art).
